ios.desc:
Stop Swiping. Start Meeting.
DATELINK is the first hardware-based coordination tool designed to eliminate the uncertainty of meeting people online. We don't just connect profiles; we use cutting-edge technology to verify physical presence in the real world.

Unlike traditional social apps that rely on endless chatting, DATELINK utilizes the U1 Chip, Nearby Interaction, and Secure GPS to cryptographically ensure that your match (or your friends) actually shows up.

THE GHOSTING KILLER: FinalMatch™ Technology
We are changing the rules of social coordination with hardware verification:

Hardware Handshake: Uses the U1 Chip (Ultra Wideband) to precisely measure the distance between two devices. Verify your meetup by simply holding your iPhones together.

Secure Check-In: A meeting is only "confirmed" when our system detects both users at the venue via encrypted Geolocation.

Reliability Score (RB): Your behavior counts. Our algorithm tracks attendance reliability. If you ghost, your score drops, and you lose visibility. We prioritize people who show up.

Live Status: Share your logistics status ("On my way," "Arrived") in real-time with one tap.

ADVANCED LOGISTICS MODES
Whether you need instant coordination or detailed planning—for yourself or your entire group:

DateNow (The Mixer): Our Instant Sync Algorithm allows two users to input preferences simultaneously. The server "mixes" the results to generate an immediate venue and time. Go from match to meetup in under an hour.

Double Dates : NEW! Coordinate with your friends for double dates . 

Classic Flow (Negotiation): A step-by-step coordination tool. You propose the venue via the map, your match selects the date. The plan is locked only when all parameters are mutually agreed upon.

THE LIVE LOBBY
15-Minute Interaction: A real-time, ephemeral connection window. No data retention, no "leaving on read."

Binary Decision: When the timer ends, both users must decide instantly: Link-up to verify and meet—or pass and move on.

VISUALIZE YOUR CITY (AR & Satellite)
Forget static lists. Analyze your surroundings with advanced sensors:

Satellite Recon: Zoom through a 3D map of your city to find active signal zones and verified users.

DATELINK Vision (AR): Activate your camera to scan for signals in Augmented Reality. Visualize profile locations overlaying the real world.
